title: Spacious Fun Retreat: 8BR|4.5BTH|Pool|Game room
description:
Welcome to our Spacious Family Retreat in Mesa, AZ!
Nestled on Roselle Ave in Mesa, our inviting retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and leisure. Whether you're seeking a peaceful getaway, a fun-filled vacation with friends and family, or for tournaments, our charming house provides everything you need for a memorable stay.

We are minutes from the Mesa Athletic Grounds, Legacy Sports Park, Hohokam Stadium, Red Mountain Baseball Complex and the Gene Autry Baseball Complex.

 The space 
Upon entering our welcoming retreat, you'll be greeted by a bright and airy atmosphere that instantly makes you feel at home. The living room is furnished with comfortable seating, perfect for lounging after a day of exploration. Catch up on your favorite shows or simply unwind with a good book next to the large pool.

The fully equipped kitchen is ready to handle all your culinary needs. Whip up delicious meals and snacks to enjoy at the dining table or large counterspace.

When it's time to rest, retreat to one of our 8 cozy bedrooms. With comfortable beds and ample storage space, you'll feel refreshed and ready for another day of adventure.

Step outside into our backyard oasis, where endless fun awaits. Take a dip in the pool to beat the heat or soak up the sun on a lounge chair. The kids can play to their heart's content while the adults relax and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

Location:

Our conveniently located retreat puts you within easy reach of Mesa's top attractions. Explore the vibrant dining scene, shop till you drop at nearby malls, or embark on outdoor adventures in the surrounding natural beauty.

Whether you're seeking relaxation or excitement, our Spacious Family Retreat in Mesa, AZ, is the perfect home base for your next getaway. Book your stay today and start planning an unforgettable vacation!

Key Features:

Private Pool: Dive into relaxation in our sparkling pool. Whether you're looking to cool off on a hot day or simply enjoy a refreshing swim, our pool is the ideal spot for some aquatic fun. The pool can be heated during the winter months and can be heated upon request for $65 a day. Please note: The time required to reach optimal temperature will depend on the ambient conditions. To ensure everything is ready for your arrival, we kindly ask that you coordinate with us at least one week in advance. Rest assured, the heating period prior to your arrival will not be charged to you.

Expansive Backyard: Our spacious backyard provides ample space for outdoor activities. Bask in the Arizona sun or unwind under the shade of the patio – the choice is yours.

Suitable For:

Our home is perfect for families and friends looking to create lasting memories together. With ample space both indoors and outdoors, everyone can enjoy quality time together while still having room for privacy.

DISCLAIMER

• Change of Reservation Date: Kindly ensure the accuracy of your reservation dates. Any changes to the dates must be requested at least 30 days before the scheduled check-in date. Failure to adhere to this policy will result in the automatic declination of the request.

• Quiet Hours: To ensure a peaceful environment for all our guests and neighbors, we kindly ask that you observe quiet hours from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. If quiet hours are breached and or law enforcement is contacted, you will be fined $500.

Floor Plan:
First floor
Bedroom 1 - Queen bed with ensuite full bathroom 
Bedroom 2 - King bed 
Bathroom - Half

Second Floor
Bedroom 3 - 2 King beds
Bedroom 4 - King bed w ensuite (Master Bedroom)
Bedroom 5 - Queen bed w ensuite full bathroom
Bedroom 6 - Queen bed
Bedroom 7 - Queen bed
Bedroom 8 – Queen bed

3 Rollaway beds 
3 Pack and plays

 Guest access 
We will send the access code 24 hours in advance before your stay along with the home address and other details.

During your stay, you will have the exclusive use of the entire home, ensuring privacy and comfort.

 Other things to note 
House Rules 

 • PETS: Pets (dogs/cats) are allowed for an extra pet fee of $150 per stay and up to 2 pets only. The unauthorized bringing of pets will have a penalty of $200 which will go towards the deep cleaning of the property.

• CHECK-IN: Check-in time is after 4PM. Early check-in requests are subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed. If we’re able to accommodate an early check-in. Please check the availability of early check-in prior to booking. 

• CHECK-OUT: Check-out time is before 10 AM. We do not allow late check-out as we schedule cleaning ahead of time. Any unauthorized late check-out will result in a charge of $50 for every 30 minutes. 

• QUIET HOURS: To ensure a peaceful environment for all our guests and neighbors, we kindly request that you observe quiet hours from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. During this time, please keep noise to a minimum both inside and outside the property. If quiet hours are breached, you will be fined $500. 

• SMOKING: We do not allow smoking inside the property or in outdoor spaces including the balcony, backyard, and terrace (if applicable). There is a smoking fine of $500. 

• NOISE: Please observe quiet hours after 10PM. Please be mindful of the neighbors as this property is situated in a quiet neighborhood. If the police are summoned due to noise complaints, this warrants a possible eviction with no refund and a fine of $500.

• DAMAGES & LOSS: We would truly appreciate it if you could treat our home like yours. You will be responsible for any damages or loss to the property which will be charged to you as additional payment request or from your security deposit (if booked from other platforms). Please advise us of any damage or loss immediately upon discovery. 

• UNAUTHORIZED GUESTS: Please make sure to book the property for the correct number of guests. Parties, events, or any kind of gathering are prohibited. No other guests outside the reservation are allowed on the property. 

• PHOTOSHOOT/MUSIC VIDEOS: This property is for residential use only and not for commercial purposes without the written permission of the owner. Please contact us directly for booking of events. 

• LOST AND FOUND: Please note that all shipping is at the traveler’s expense. There is a minimum $25 shipping cost plus a $50 service fee. We are not liable for any lost items. Our team will do our best to locate your lost items after check-out. 

• MAILS & PACKAGES: We do not allow any mail deliveries or packages during your stay. 

• BBQ GRILL: Usage and propane tank refill is available and should be coordinated 2-3 days prior to your stay for a fee for service charge. Please note that guests are kindly requested to clean the BBQ grill thoroughly after each use. There will be a cleaning fee if not cleaned after your stay.

• POOL HEAT: Heated pool service is available and must be coordinated 3-5 days prior to your stay for a fee for the duration of your stay. 
***PLEASE DO NOT HANG ON THE HOOP OR RIM.

• CHANGE OF RESERVATION DATE: Kindly ensure the accuracy of your reservation dates. Any changes to the dates must be requested at least 30 days before the scheduled check-in date. Failure to adhere to this policy will result in the automatic declination of the request.

• ADDITIONAL NOTES ABOUT THE HOME

- Pool Maintenance: A pool maintenance personnel will be on property to maintain the pool. They will not be accessing the home.

- Landscaper: A landscaper will be on property to maintain property grounds. They will not be accessing the home.

- Visits and Property Access: We will always notify you in advance should there be a need to access the home and no one will ever enter without your approval. An exception is if there is a fire or life-threatening situations in the home.
